cases.instruction: Create a new Rider account in the OpenDriver application and complete a sequence of ride selections, support ticket creations, and account inspections before logging out. The new account must be established by selecting the Rider account tab on the login screen and entering the name Scan Rider, the email address scan.rider@example.com, and the password Pass123!. The ride workflow requires selecting the destination Downtown Palo Alto, CA from the Ride tab, choosing a ride, and selecting the RideX option while ensuring the Promo code field is completely empty; this specific configuration must be confirmed to display the quote, with any order completion prompt dismissed by selecting Done. This ride selection process must be repeated multiple times, including after navigating to the Active tab to select Request a ride, after visiting the History tab to open the Ride history page and interact with the central list area, and after inspecting various account subpages. The Safety and support section must contain two distinct support tickets created by entering the exact text I need help with my ride. in the Message text box and selecting Create support ticket, followed by entering the exact text Follow up on my ride. in the Message text box and selecting Create support ticket again, with the open ticket list area remaining visible on the Safety page. The Account tab must be used to interact with the Scan Rider account information area, select the Edit profile entry, and subsequently view the Wallet, Coupons, Notifications, and Saved places entries, returning to the main Account tab after each inspection. The final state of the application must be the logged-out OpenDriver login/create-account page with no active Rider session controls visible, achieved by selecting the exit icon in the top-left corner of the window after ensuring the final business page is the Scan Rider account page.

Lucas Lin's initial order should come from Dumpling Room No. 20 San Jose CA, found with the `dumpling` search, Chinese cuisine filter, and Rating sort. Lucas Lin should place a second order by reordering his delivered Dumpling Room order with 1 Pork Dumplings and 1 Beef Chow Fun and explicitly selecting No coupon. cases.instruction: Create two delivered coupon orders, a support ticket, and a courier route progression in the OpenFood application, ending with the customer account active and the restaurant list filtered for Chinese dumplings. The first order, placed as Lucas Lin - Customer, must be for Santana Row Banh Mi Market No. 12 San Jose CA and contain 2 Golden San Jose Pho Tai Rice and 1 Golden San Jose Pho Tai Soup with the coupon WELCOME12 - $12 off orders over $30 applied, discovered by searching for banh with the Cuisine filter set to Vietnamese and the Sort option set to Fastest. The second order, also placed as Lucas Lin - Customer, must be for Dumpling Room No. 20 San Jose CA and contain 3 Pork Dumplings and 1 Beef Chow Fun with the same WELCOME12 - $12 off orders over $30 coupon applied, discovered by searching for dumpling with the Cuisine filter set to Chinese and the Sort option set to Rating. Both orders must have their status advanced twice by Noah Park - Merchant to reach Delivered. The menu item Golden San Jose Pho Tai Snack at Santana Row Banh Mi Market No. 12 San Jose CA must be marked unavailable by the merchant. The courier Ava Chen - Courier must accept the route for delivery card D-333 - Station Queens Dumpling No. 33 New York City NY and select Next step on that card. An intermediate reorder action initiated by Lucas Lin - Customer from the first delivered order must be performed, adjusting the cart to 1 Golden San Jose Pho Tai Rice and 2 Golden San Jose Pho Tai Soup, but this cart must be cleared without placing an order. The final state of the application must be signed in as Lucas Lin - Customer with an empty cart, no active coupon, the restaurant Dumpling Room No. 20 San Jose CA selected, and the restaurant filters set to the search term dumpling, Cuisine Chinese, and Sort Rating.

cases.instruction:
1. 单击左侧栏中的“Log In”按钮，打开“Log in to OpenNote”登录窗口。
2. 单击登录窗口顶部的“Code Login”标签，切换到验证码登录表单。
3. 保留默认手机号 `13800000000` 和验证码 `2026`，单击红色“Log In”按钮登录 Lina Park 账号。
4. 单击左侧导航栏中的“Post”，开始记录论坛抵达着装。
5. 单击 New Note 表单的 Title 输入框。
6. 在 Title 中输入 `Forum Arrival Outfit`。
7. 单击 Body 多行编辑区。
8. 在 Body 中输入 `Layer a comfortable coat over the travel outfit.`，按 Enter 建立外套搭配条目。
9. 在 Body 中输入 `Keep the ID pouch outside the coat for check-in.`，按 Enter 建立证件袋条目。
10. 在 Body 中输入 `Wear flat shoes for the walk across the forum plaza.`，按 Enter 建立平底鞋条目。
11. 在 Body 中输入 `Straighten the coat collar before the arrival photo.`，然后按 Enter 换行。
12. 在 Body 中输入 `Keep the forum badge visible above the coat pocket.`，然后按 Enter 换行。
13. 在 Body 中输入 `Get a cold brew only after the registration handoff.`，然后按 Enter 换行。
14. 在 Body 中输入 `Pack a light tote for the schedule and notebook.`，然后按 Enter 换行。
15. 在 Body 中输入 `Meet the full travel group at the plaza by noon.`。
16. 单击“Category”下拉框。
17. 在分类菜单中选择“Fashion”。
18. 单击 Location 输入框。
19. 在 Location 中输入 `Forum entrance plaza`。
20. 单击 Tags 输入框。
21. 在 Tags 中输入 `forum trip outfit`。
22. 在 Cover 网格中单击第八张“黑色西装人物坐在咖啡桌旁”的图片，使其红框选中并作为本帖唯一封面。
23. 在 New Note 表单页面向下滚动，直到“Publish”按钮可见，以便后续单击该按钮提交论坛抵达着装记录。
24. 单击“Publish”，发布 `Forum Arrival Outfit`。
25. 在个人 Posts 列表区域向下滚动，直到“I tried this old-street photo walks 17 times until it finally worked”卡片可见，以便后续单击该卡片并设置收藏状态。
26. 单击“I tried this old-street photo walks 17 times until it finally worked”帖子。
27. 单击当前未激活的“Like”，将这篇老街摄影散步笔记设为已点赞。
28. 单击当前未激活的“Save”，将这篇老街摄影散步笔记设为已收藏。
29. 单击详情右上角圆形关闭按钮，返回个人 Posts 列表继续维护论坛资料。
30. 在个人 Posts 列表区域向上滚动，直到页首“Edit Profile”按钮可见，以便后续单击该按钮编辑并保存论坛身份。
31. 单击个人页顶部的“Edit Profile”。
32. 单击“Bio”输入框。
33. 在 Bio 现有内容末尾输入 ` Forum travel editor`。
34. 单击“Save Profile”，保存论坛差旅编辑简介。
35. 单击左侧导航栏中的“Post”，开始编排两日论坛计划。
36. 单击 Title 输入框。
37. 在 Title 中输入 `Two Day Forum Plan`。
38. 单击 Body 多行编辑区。
39. 在 Body 中输入 `Wear the easy coat for all first-day sessions.`，按 Enter 建立首日外套条目。
40. 在 Body 中输入 `Prepare a lighter outfit for the planning session.`，按 Enter 建立准备会着装条目。
41. 在 Body 中输入 `Bring the marked session notes on the second day.`，按 Enter 建立次日笔记条目。
42. 在 Body 中输入 `Leave enough time for weather-related outfit changes.`，然后按 Enter 换行。
43. 在 Body 中输入 `Place every badge clearly for the group photograph.`，然后按 Enter 换行。
44. 在 Body 中输入 `Use one neutral tote for papers and small devices.`，然后按 Enter 换行。
45. 在 Body 中输入 `Keep the evening layer ready near the seminar room.`。
46. 单击“Category”下拉框。
47. 在分类菜单中选择“Fashion”。
48. 单击 Location 输入框。
49. 在 Location 中输入 `Forum resource area`。
50. 在 New Note 表单页面向下滚动，直到 Tags 输入框可见，以便后续设置 Tags、选择封面并提交两日论坛计划。
51. 单击 Tags 输入框。
52. 在 Tags 中输入 `forum plan attire`。
53. 在 Cover 网格中单击第十二张“蓝色上衣人物背靠站在窗边”的图片，使其红框选中并作为本帖唯一封面。
54. 在 New Note 表单页面向下滚动，直到“Publish”按钮可见，以便后续单击该按钮提交两日论坛计划。
55. 单击“Publish”，发布 `Two Day Forum Plan`。
56. 单击左侧导航栏中的“Post”，开始记录小组发言着装。
57. 单击 Title 输入框。
58. 在 Title 中输入 `Group Session Outfit`。
59. 单击 Body 多行编辑区。
60. 在 Body 中输入 `Wear a light top that stays neat while speaking.`，然后按 Enter 换行。
61. 在 Body 中输入 `Pin the forum badge clearly on the upper chest.`，然后按 Enter 换行。
62. 在 Body 中输入 `Keep both cuffs free for writing session notes.`，然后按 Enter 换行。
63. 在 Body 中输入 `Avoid bright colors that distract from the speaker.`，然后按 Enter 换行。
64. 在 Body 中输入 `Keep the full outfit tidy throughout the talk.`，然后按 Enter 换行。
65. 在 Body 中输入 `Line up with the group for the closing photograph.`，然后按 Enter 换行。
66. 在 Body 中输入 `Carry the printed agenda card in the front pocket.`，按 Enter 建立议程卡条目。
67. 在 Body 中输入 `Leave enough room to add a jacket after sunset.`。
68. 单击“Category”下拉框。
69. 在分类菜单中选择“Fashion”。
70. 单击 Location 输入框。
71. 在 Location 中输入 `Forum seminar room`。
72. 单击 Tags 输入框。
73. 在 Tags 中输入 `forum session attire`。
74. 在 Cover 网格中单击第十六张“托特包、衣架和服装陈列”的图片，使其红框选中并作为本帖唯一封面。
75. 在 New Note 表单页面向下滚动，直到“Publish”按钮可见，以便后续单击该按钮提交小组发言着装记录。
76. 单击“Publish”，提交并发布 `Group Session Outfit`。

cases.instruction:
1. 单击左侧栏中的“Log In”按钮，打开“Log in to OpenNote”登录窗口。
2. 单击登录窗口顶部的“Code Login”标签，切换到验证码登录表单。
3. 保留默认手机号 `13800000000` 和验证码 `2026`，单击红色“Log In”按钮登录 Lina Park 账号。
4. 单击左侧 Lina Park 账号卡片下方的“My Profile”。
5. 单击个人页顶部的“Edit Profile”。
6. 单击“Role”输入框。
7. 在 Role 现有内容末尾输入 ` Live music editor`。
8. 单击“Save Profile”，保存现场音乐编辑角色。
9. 单击左侧导航栏中的“Post”，开始建立吉他造型记录。
10. 单击 New Note 表单的 Title 输入框。
11. 在 Title 中输入 `Blue Green Guitar`。
12. 单击 Body 多行编辑区。
13. 在 Body 中输入 `Record the blue and green finish on the guitar body.`，按 Enter 建立琴身配色条目。
14. 在 Body 中输入 `Note how the instrument colors read on stage.`，按 Enter 建立舞台色彩条目。
15. 在 Body 中输入 `Use those colors to guide the full stage styling.`，按 Enter 建立演出造型条目。
16. 在 Body 中输入 `Match the guitar strap with the dark denim layer.`，然后按 Enter 换行。
17. 在 Body 中输入 `Keep the main spotlight cool during this song.`。
18. 单击“Category”下拉框。
19. 在分类菜单中选择“Fashion”。
20. 单击 Location 输入框。
21. 在 Location 中输入 `Riverside backstage`。
22. 单击 Tags 输入框。
23. 在 Tags 中输入 `Guitar blue green`。
24. 在 Cover 网格第一行中单击第二张“灰色外套人物站在衣橱旁”的图片，使其红框选中并作为本帖唯一封面。
25. 在 New Note 表单页面向下滚动，直到“Publish”按钮可见，以便后续单击该按钮提交吉他造型记录。
26. 单击“Publish”，发布 `Blue Green Guitar`。
27. 单击左侧导航栏中的“Explore”，寻找可合作的造型作者。
28. 单击“shoe pairings: small changes that keeps the whole closet simpler”帖子。
29. 单击当前未激活的“Follow”，持续关注这位造型作者。
30. 单击“shoe pairings: small changes that keeps the whole closet simpler”帖子。
31. 单击当前未激活的“Like”，将这篇鞋履搭配笔记设为已点赞。
32. 单击详情右上角圆形关闭按钮，返回 Explore 信息流继续音乐视觉企划。
33. 单击左侧导航栏中的“Post”。
34. 单击 Title 输入框。
35. 在 Title 中输入 `Live Music Visuals`。
36. 单击 Body 多行编辑区。
37. 在 Body 中输入 `Link the guitar palette to every visual layout.`，按 Enter 建立吉他配色关联。
38. 在 Body 中输入 `Plan two side portraits beside the stage curtain.`，按 Enter 建立侧面肖像机位。
39. 在 Body 中输入 `Use one consistent layout for all media cards.`，按 Enter 建立媒体版式规则。
40. 在 Body 中输入 `Reserve one warm frame for the closing interview.`，然后按 Enter 换行。
41. 在 Body 中输入 `List the approved camera angles for each interview.`。
42. 单击“Category”下拉框。
43. 在分类菜单中选择“Fashion”。
44. 单击 Location 输入框。
45. 在 Location 中输入 `Media interview zone`。
46. 单击 Tags 输入框。
47. 在 Tags 中输入 `live music visuals`。
48. 在 Cover 网格中单击第三张“多套人物造型与衣橱的拼图”图片，使其红框选中并作为本帖唯一封面。
49. 在 New Note 表单页面向下滚动，直到“Publish”按钮可见，以便后续单击该按钮提交现场音乐视觉方案。
50. 单击“Publish”，发布 `Live Music Visuals`。
51. 单击左侧导航栏中的“Explore”。
52. 单击顶部分类栏中的“Fashion”。
53. 单击“A half-day version of seasonal jackets that keeps the whole closet simpler”笔记卡片。
54. 单击当前未激活的“Like”，将季节外套笔记设为已点赞。
55. 单击详情右上角圆形关闭按钮，返回 Fashion 列表继续完成肖像方案。
56. 单击左侧导航栏中的“Post”。
57. 单击 Title 输入框。
58. 在 Title 中输入 `Curly Musician Photo`。
59. 单击 Body 多行编辑区。
60. 在 Body 中输入 `Record the musician's curly silhouette from the side.`，按 Enter 建立卷发轮廓条目。
61. 在 Body 中输入 `Match the portrait with the blue and green set.`，按 Enter 建立蓝绿布景匹配条目。
62. 在 Body 中输入 `Prepare the selected portrait for the media cover.`，按 Enter 建立媒体封面用途条目。
63. 在 Body 中输入 `Keep one close portrait with a relaxed expression.`，然后按 Enter 换行。
64. 在 Body 中输入 `Frame the lower stage lights behind the musician.`。
65. 单击“Category”下拉框。
66. 在分类菜单中选择“Fashion”。
67. 单击 Location 输入框。
68. 在 Location 中输入 `Riverside side stage`。
69. 单击 Tags 输入框。
70. 在 Tags 中输入 `musician curly stage`。
71. 在 Cover 网格第一行中单击第四张“黑色西装人物站在暖光衣橱前”的图片，使其红框选中并作为本帖唯一封面。
72. 在 New Note 表单页面向下滚动，直到“Publish”按钮可见，以便后续单击该按钮提交音乐人肖像帖。
73. 单击“Publish”，提交并发布 `Curly Musician Photo`。

cases.instruction: Complete a round-trip travel booking workflow inside the macOS1 guest environment, beginning by signing in with the pre-filled Lucas Lin account on the OpenTrip login form. The outbound flight booking must be for a Business class flight from Shanghai to Sanya on June 15, 2026, sorted by lowest price, specifically selecting the MetroJet MJ1386 flight with a 15kg checked bag added. This outbound booking confirmation must list the traveler as Maya Chen · Passport, use the contact phone number 13900004201, and select Bank Card · Credit or debit card as the payment method before submission. The hotel booking must be for the Sanya Meridian Suites hotel with a check-in date of June 15, 2026, and a check-out date of June 17, 2026, sorted by lowest price, specifically booking a Deluxe Twin Room. This hotel booking confirmation must use the contact phone number 13900004202, select WeChat Pay · Scan or authorize payment as the payment method, include the note Quiet room please, and be submitted. The return flight booking must be for a flight from Sanya (SYX) to Shanghai (SHA) on June 17, 2026, sorted by earliest departure, selecting the first flight card in the results with a 23kg checked bag added. This return booking confirmation must use the contact phone number 13900004203, select Bank Card · Credit or debit card as the payment method, and be submitted. A new plain text document created in TextEdit within the macOS1 guest environment must contain exactly three lines: DATES=JUN15-17, OUT=MJ1386 15KG, and HOTEL=TWIN RET23, and must be saved as Sanya-Jun15.txt to the Desktop. The task is complete when the Lucas Lin account remains signed in, all three bookings are confirmed with the specified details, and the TextEdit application is the foreground window displaying the saved file.
cases.evaluationMessage: OpenTrip bookings, event sequence, final TextEdit UI, and guest text file passed

cases.instruction: Sign in to the OpenShop app with the account for Lucas Lin and the password “spring2026”, then complete two distinct checkout transactions and submit two product reviews. The first order must contain four items in this exact sequence: the “Mountain Isle Pour-Over Coffee 20 Pack” with the “40 sachets $143.55” specification from the Grocery category, the “Verdant Pro Noise-Canceling Headphones” with the “White $299” specification found by searching “Verdant Pro” within the Electronics category, the “Lumen Fast-Charge LED Desk Lamp” from the Office category, and the “Orbit Smart Phone Stand” with the “Black” specification found by searching “Orbit Smart”. The quantity of the “Verdant Pro Noise-Canceling Headphones” in this first cart must be increased to two. The checkout for this first order must use the “Home” address card, “Alipay” as the payment method, and include “Front desk by 6” in the Order Note field. The checkout for this second order must use the “Office” address card and “WeChat Pay” as the payment method.

driver.execute_script("mobile: touchAndHold", {"x": 175, "y": 581, "duration": 1.0})

# The message menu is open on Bob’s exact marker message; I’ll copy its text.
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": 72, "y": 416})

# Bob’s marker message was copied. I’ll return to the conversation list to find the other required historical messages.
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": 57, "y": 234})

# The chat is still open; the previous tap used screenshot pixels rather than logical coordinates. I’ll tap the back arrow at its logical position.
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": 18, "y": 78})

# The chat list is visible now. I’ll open Nora QA to find and copy the exact message containing its search token.
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": 115, "y": 255})

# Nora’s exact token message is visible; I’ll long-press it to bring up copy options.
driver.execute_script("mobile: touchAndHold", {"x": 170, "y": 500, "duration": 1.2})

# The message’s context menu is open. I’ll copy its exact text, then return to the chat list for the next source message.
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": 62, "y": 288})
time.sleep(0.5)
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": 18, "y": 78})

# Nora’s exact message has been copied and the chat list is back. I’ll open Mei Chen to locate the route handoff message.
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": 115, "y": 780})

# Mei’s historical “update 03” contains the requested route token. I’ll open its menu to copy the complete message.
size = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: touchAndHold", {"x": size["width"] * 0.40, "y": size["height"] * 0.675, "duration": 1.2})
time.sleep(0.5)

# The selected message matches Mei’s requested token. I’ll copy it and open the Home screen to switch to FSNotes.
size = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": size["width"] * 0.18, "y": size["height"] * 0.498})
time.sleep(0.5)
driver.execute_script("mobile: pressButton", {"name": "home"})
time.sleep(0.5)

# Mei’s message is copied. I’ll find FSNotes through Home screen search.
s = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": s["width"] * 0.5, "y": s["height"] * 0.815})
time.sleep(0.5)
driver.switch_to.active_element.send_keys("FSNotes")
time.sleep(0.5)

# FSNotes is the Top Hit; I’ll open it to create the note.
s = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": s["width"] * 0.17, "y": s["height"] * 0.155})
time.sleep(1.5)

# FSNotes is open. I’ll select Notes and enter the requested title in Search or create.
driver.find_element(AppiumBy.ACCESSIBILITY_ID, "Notes").click()
time.sleep(0.5)
s = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": s["width"] * 0.37, "y": s["height"] * 0.945})
driver.switch_to.active_element.send_keys("Handoff Log 0728")
time.sleep(0.5)

# The title is entered with no matching note. I’ll confirm it to create the note.
driver.switch_to.active_element.send_keys("\n")
time.sleep(0.7)

# The new note contains the title as body text. I’ll replace it with the opening lines, then inspect the note menu for naming.
editor = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.CLASS_NAME, "XCUIElementTypeTextView")
editor.clear()
editor.send_keys("# Handoff log\nRoute handoff\n")
time.sleep(0.5)
s = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": s["width"] * 0.905, "y": s["height"] * 0.088})
time.sleep(0.5)

# The opening lines are in place, and the menu provides Rename. I’ll check the filename.
driver.find_element(AppiumBy.ACCESSIBILITY_ID, "Rename").click()
time.sleep(0.5)

# FSNotes derived the filename from the header. I’ll set the requested name, then locate Delta Chat.
field = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.CLASS_NAME, "XCUIElementTypeTextField")
field.clear()
field.send_keys("Handoff Log 0728")
driver.find_element(AppiumBy.ACCESSIBILITY_ID, "OK").click()
time.sleep(0.5)
driver.execute_script("mobile: pressButton", {"name": "home"})
time.sleep(0.5)

# The Home Screen is open. I’ll use Spotlight to find Delta Chat.
s = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": s["width"] * 0.5, "y": s["height"] * 0.815})
time.sleep(0.5)
driver.switch_to.active_element.send_keys("Delta Chat")
time.sleep(0.5)

# Spotlight found Delta Chat. I’ll open it to retrieve the historical messages.
s = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": s["width"] * 0.17, "y": s["height"] * 0.16})
time.sleep(0.7)

# Mei’s conversation is open, with several token references visible. I’ll inspect the earlier message before copying.
s = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: dragFromToForDuration", {"fromX": s["width"] * 0.5, "fromY": s["height"] * 0.24, "toX": s["width"] * 0.5, "toY": s["height"] * 0.73, "duration": 0.6})
time.sleep(0.5)

# The drag did not move the conversation. I’ll swipe down to reveal older messages.
driver.execute_script("mobile: swipe", {"direction": "down"})
time.sleep(0.5)

# The conversation remains in the same position. I’ll inspect its accessible controls to target the message list.
print(driver.page_source)

# The message list is exposed as a table. I’ll scroll that table directly toward the older history.
table = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.CLASS_NAME, "XCUIElementTypeTable")
driver.execute_script("mobile: scroll", {"elementId": table.id, "direction": "up"})
time.sleep(0.5)

# Mei’s visible historical message contains the required route token. I’ll open its copy menu.
size = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: touchAndHold", {"x": size["width"] * 0.40, "y": size["height"] * 0.675, "duration": 1.0})
time.sleep(0.5)

# The selected message is Mei’s route-token message. I’ll copy it and go to the Home Screen to open FSNotes.
driver.find_element(AppiumBy.ACCESSIBILITY_ID, "Copy").click()
time.sleep(0.5)
driver.execute_script("mobile: pressButton", {"name": "home"})
time.sleep(0.5)

# Mei’s message is copied. I’ll find FSNotes through Home Screen search.
driver.find_element(AppiumBy.ACCESSIBILITY_ID, "Search").click()
time.sleep(0.5)
driver.switch_to.active_element.send_keys("FSNotes")
time.sleep(0.5)

# FSNotes is the top search result; I’ll open it.
size = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": size["width"] * 0.17, "y": size["height"] * 0.16})
time.sleep(0.7)

# The note already has its first two lines, with the caret on line three. I’ll open the paste menu for Mei’s copied message.
size = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: touchAndHold", {"x": size["width"] * 0.04, "y": size["height"] * 0.211, "duration": 1.0})
time.sleep(0.5)

# The paste menu is open at line three. I’ll paste the copied message.
driver.find_element(AppiumBy.ACCESSIBILITY_ID, "Paste").click()
time.sleep(0.5)

# Mei’s message is pasted correctly. I’ll add the owner line, then return Home to open Delta Chat for Nora’s message.
driver.switch_to.active_element.send_keys("\nOwner Mei\n")
time.sleep(0.5)
driver.execute_script("mobile: pressButton", {"name": "home"})
time.sleep(0.5)

# FSNotes is backgrounded on the Home Screen. I’ll use Spotlight to launch Delta Chat and locate Nora’s conversation.
size = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": int(size["width"] * 0.5), "y": int(size["height"] * 0.82)})
time.sleep(0.5)
driver.switch_to.active_element.send_keys("Delta Chat")
time.sleep(1.0)

# Spotlight shows Delta Chat as the top hit. I’ll open it.
size = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": int(size["width"] * 0.17), "y": int(size["height"] * 0.16)})
time.sleep(0.8)

# Delta Chat reopened Mei’s thread. I’ll return to the chat list to find Nora QA.
size = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": int(size["width"] * 0.045), "y": int(size["height"] * 0.082)})
time.sleep(0.5)

# The chat list is loaded and Nora QA is visible. I’ll open Nora’s conversation and locate the historical message containing the required token.
size = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": int(size["width"] * 0.38), "y": int(size["height"] * 0.375)})
time.sleep(0.8)

# Nora’s required text message is visible. I’ll open its menu to copy the exact content.
size = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: touchAndHold", {"x": int(size["width"] * 0.4), "y": int(size["height"] * 0.523), "duration": 1.0})
time.sleep(0.5)

# The menu offers Copy for Nora’s exact message. I’ll copy it and return to the Home Screen to open FSNotes.
driver.find_element(AppiumBy.ACCESSIBILITY_ID, "Copy").click()
time.sleep(0.5)
driver.execute_script("mobile: pressButton", {"name": "home"})
time.sleep(0.5)

# The simulator is on the Home Screen. I’ll use Spotlight to find and open FSNotes.
size = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: swipe", {"startX": int(size["width"]*0.5), "startY": int(size["height"]*0.12), "endX": int(size["width"]*0.5), "endY": int(size["height"]*0.65), "duration": 0.3})
time.sleep(0.5)
driver.switch_to.active_element.send_keys("FSNotes")
time.sleep(0.8)

# The prior swipe failed because this Appium version requires a direction parameter. I’ll open Spotlight with a downward swipe.
driver.execute_script("mobile: swipe", {"direction": "down", "velocity": 1200})
time.sleep(0.8)

# Spotlight opened with the previous Delta Chat query selected. I’ll replace it with FSNotes.
driver.switch_to.active_element.send_keys("FSNotes")
time.sleep(0.7)

# FSNotes is now the top result. I’ll open it to create the handoff note.
driver.find_element(AppiumBy.ACCESSIBILITY_ID, "FSNotes").click()
time.sleep(0.8)

# The screen remains in Spotlight, so I’ll tap the FSNotes app icon directly.
size = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": size["width"] * 0.169, "y": size["height"] * 0.159})
time.sleep(1)

# The note already contains the first four lines, ending with “Owner Mei”. I’ll open the paste menu at the next line.
size = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: touchAndHold", {"x": size["width"] * 0.04, "y": size["height"] * 0.29, "duration": 1})
time.sleep(0.5)

# The paste menu is open at line five. I’ll paste the clipboard content and check the inserted message.
driver.find_element(AppiumBy.ACCESSIBILITY_ID, "Paste").click()
time.sleep(0.5)

# Nora’s message is pasted with the required token. I’ll add the last two lines of the initial version and open the note menu.
driver.switch_to.active_element.send_keys("\nReceiver Nora\nStatus offered")
time.sleep(0.5)
size = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": size["width"] * 0.906, "y": size["height"] * 0.088})
time.sleep(0.5)

# The initial text is complete. I’ll rename the file before sharing its seven-line version.
driver.find_element(AppiumBy.ACCESSIBILITY_ID, "Rename").click()
time.sleep(0.5)

# The current filename is selected in the rename dialog. I’ll set the requested title and open Share.
driver.switch_to.active_element.send_keys("Handoff Log 0728")
driver.find_element(AppiumBy.ACCESSIBILITY_ID, "OK").click()
time.sleep(0.5)
size = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": size["width"] * 0.906, "y": size["height"] * 0.088})
time.sleep(0.5)
driver.find_element(AppiumBy.ACCESSIBILITY_ID, "Share").click()
time.sleep(0.5)

# The share sheet shows “Handoff Log 0728” as a Markdown attachment. I’ll choose Delta Chat.
driver.find_element(AppiumBy.ACCESSIBILITY_ID, "Delta Chat").click()
time.sleep(0.5)

# Delta Chat is visible, but its accessibility lookup failed. I’ll tap its share icon directly.
size = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": size["width"] * 0.169, "y": size["height"] * 0.374})
time.sleep(0.5)

# Delta Chat is asking for the destination. I’ll select Saved Messages for the first attachment.
size = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": size["width"] * 0.405, "y": size["height"] * 0.190})
time.sleep(0.5)

# The confirmation targets Saved Messages and includes one file. I’ll confirm the share.
size = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": size["width"] * 0.50, "y": size["height"] * 0.867})
time.sleep(0.5)

# The first attachment is now in Saved Messages with the required filename. I’ll open Alice Design to find her historical message.
size = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": size["width"] * 0.043, "y": size["height"] * 0.082})
time.sleep(0.5)
driver.find_element(AppiumBy.IOS_PREDICATE, "type == 'XCUIElementTypeStaticText' AND name == 'Alice Design'").click()
time.sleep(0.5)

# Alice’s target message is visible. I’ll open Bob Ops and locate the message containing his token.
size = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": size["width"] * 0.043, "y": size["height"] * 0.082})
time.sleep(0.5)
driver.find_element(AppiumBy.IOS_PREDICATE, "type == 'XCUIElementTypeStaticText' AND name == 'Bob Ops'").click()
time.sleep(0.5)

# Bob’s historical message is visible: “Bob update 02: ops_launch_green_2026 is the status marker.” I’ll return to FSNotes to extend the existing note.
size = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": size["width"] * 0.103, "y": size["height"] * 0.046})
time.sleep(0.5)

# The seven-line note is intact, with the cursor at its end. I’ll append “Design packet” and return to Delta Chat to copy Alice’s message.
driver.switch_to.active_element.send_keys("\nDesign packet\n")
time.sleep(0.5)
driver.activate_app("chat.delta.ios")
time.sleep(0.5)

# “Design packet” was added successfully. The Delta Chat app identifier was incorrect, so I’ll open it from the Home screen.
driver.execute_script("mobile: pressButton", {"name": "home"})
time.sleep(0.5)

# Delta Chat is not on this Home screen page. I’ll check the next page.
driver.execute_script("mobile: swipe", {"direction": "left"})
time.sleep(0.5)

# Delta Chat is visible on this page. I’ll open it to locate Alice’s historical message.
driver.find_element(AppiumBy.ACCESSIBILITY_ID, "Delta Chat").click()
time.sleep(0.5)

cases.title: Build a saved launch checklist
cases.summary: Follow the recorded actions and compare the final screenshot with the archived evaluator verdict.
cases.focus: This is a selected archived attempt, not an aggregate score or a claim that every action succeeded. The episode runner reported FAIL; its status is separate from the final-state evaluator.
cases.evidence: Archived final-state evaluator: FAIL. This verdict is preserved from the source run.
cases.instruction: Create a new Markdown note in FSNotes titled “Launch Gate 0728” and populate it with the following content in this exact order, with each item on its own logical line: “# Launch gate”, “Readiness draft”, the complete historical message from Bob Ops that contains “ops_launch_green_2026”, “Build 166”, “Owner Bob”, “Ops green”, “Cutover route”, the complete historical message from Mei Chen that contains “route_final_blue_1740”, “Window 1740”, “Mobile verifier”, the complete historical message from Nora QA that contains “nav_bar_search_token_nora_2606”, “Gate ship ready”, “Decision proceed”, “Support Nora”, “Evidence linked”, “Risk no Sev1”, “Monitor active”, and “Status ready”. The readiness draft (the first 6 logical lines, ending at “Ops green”) must be shared to Delta Chat’s Saved Messages as a file attachment first. After the note is extended to all 18 logical lines, the final 18-line version must be shared to Delta Chat’s Saved Messages as a second file attachment that is byte-identical to the FSNotes file. The complete historical message from Bob Ops that contains “ops_launch_green_2026” must be forwarded to Delta Chat’s Saved Messages after both attachments. The final state must include the FSNotes file containing all 18 logical lines in the specified order, and the Delta Chat Saved Messages must contain exactly three new items in chronological order: the readiness-draft attachment, the final note attachment, and the forwarded Bob Ops message.
cases.evaluationMessage: Launch Gate workflow is missing or mismatches required durable evidence

steps.code:
# Bob’s thread shows several newer marker references; I’ll inspect the earlier messages for the complete historical message.
driver.execute_script("mobile: swipe", {"direction": "down"})
time.sleep(0.5)

# The swipe left the chat unchanged; I’ll drag downward to reveal older Bob Ops messages.
size = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: dragFromToForDuration", {
    "duration": 0.7,
    "fromX": size["width"] * 0.5, "fromY": size["height"] * 0.28,
    "toX": size["width"] * 0.5, "toY": size["height"] * 0.82
})
time.sleep(0.5)

# The drag opened a message menu instead of scrolling. I’ll dismiss it and use a quick downward swipe.
size = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": size["width"] * 0.85, "y": size["height"] * 0.65})
time.sleep(0.5)
driver.swipe(int(size["width"] * 0.5), int(size["height"] * 0.25),
             int(size["width"] * 0.5), int(size["height"] * 0.8), 250)
time.sleep(0.5)

# The menu is dismissed, but the chat hasn’t scrolled. I’ll tap the status bar to jump to older messages.
size = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": size["width"] * 0.19, "y": size["height"] * 0.033})
time.sleep(0.5)
print(driver.page_source)

# The status-bar tap moved to newer messages. I’ll scroll toward older history and read the message text.
table = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.CLASS_NAME, "XCUIElementTypeTable")
driver.execute_script("mobile: swipe", {"direction": "down", "elementId": table.id})
time.sleep(0.5)
print([e.get_attribute("label") for e in driver.find_elements(AppiumBy.CLASS_NAME, "XCUIElementTypeStaticText")])

# The exact Bob message is “Bob update 02: ops_launch_green_2026 is the status marker.” I’ll leave Delta Chat and open FSNotes from the simulator home screen.
driver.execute_script("mobile: pressButton", {"name": "home"})
time.sleep(1)

# FSNotes isn’t on this home page. I’ll use Spotlight to locate it.
size = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": size["width"] * 0.5, "y": size["height"] * 0.815})
time.sleep(0.5)
driver.switch_to.active_element.send_keys("FSNotes")
time.sleep(0.5)

# Spotlight found FSNotes. I’ll open it and inspect the controls for creating the draft.
size = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": size["width"] * 0.17, "y": size["height"] * 0.16})
time.sleep(0.7)
print(driver.page_source)

# FSNotes is open in Carrier Updates. I’ll switch to Notes and enter the new note’s title.
driver.find_element(AppiumBy.ACCESSIBILITY_ID, "Notes").click()
time.sleep(0.5)
size = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": size["width"] * 0.4, "y": size["height"] * 0.945})
time.sleep(0.5)
driver.switch_to.active_element.send_keys("Launch Gate 0728")
time.sleep(0.5)
print([(e.get_attribute("type"), e.get_attribute("name")) for e in driver.find_elements(AppiumBy.IOS_PREDICATE, 'type == "XCUIElementTypeButton" OR type == "XCUIElementTypeSearchField" OR type == "XCUIElementTypeTextField"')])

# The title is entered in Search or create. I’ll confirm it and use the compose button.
driver.find_element(AppiumBy.ACCESSIBILITY_ID, "Done").click()
time.sleep(0.5)
size = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": size["width"] * 0.885, "y": size["height"] * 0.945})
time.sleep(0.5)
print([(e.get_attribute("type"), e.get_attribute("name"), e.get_attribute("value")) for e in driver.find_elements(AppiumBy.IOS_PREDICATE, 'type == "XCUIElementTypeTextView" OR type == "XCUIElementTypeTextField" OR type == "XCUIElementTypeButton"')])

# Confirming the search created a note; the extra tap opened Dictation. I’ll dismiss that prompt and inspect note actions.
driver.find_element(AppiumBy.ACCESSIBILITY_ID, "Not Now").click()
time.sleep(0.5)
size = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": size["width"] * 0.905, "y": size["height"] * 0.088})
time.sleep(0.5)
print(driver.page_source[:14000])

# The note exists as a Markdown file with a generated filename. I’ll rename it to Launch Gate 0728.
driver.find_element(AppiumBy.ACCESSIBILITY_ID, "Rename").click()
time.sleep(0.5)
print([(e.get_attribute("type"), e.get_attribute("name"), e.get_attribute("value")) for e in driver.find_elements(AppiumBy.IOS_PREDICATE, 'visible == true AND (type == "XCUIElementTypeTextField" OR type == "XCUIElementTypeButton" OR type == "XCUIElementTypeStaticText")')])

# The rename dialog is ready. I’ll set the filename, start the note, then locate the historical messages.
field = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.CLASS_NAME, "XCUIElementTypeTextField")
field.clear()
field.send_keys("Launch Gate 0728")
driver.find_element(AppiumBy.ACCESSIBILITY_ID, "OK").click()
time.sleep(0.5)
editor = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.CLASS_NAME, "XCUIElementTypeTextView")
editor.click()
editor.clear()
editor.send_keys("# Launch gate\nReadiness draft")
time.sleep(0.5)
print("Note content:", editor.get_attribute("value"))
driver.find_element(AppiumBy.ACCESSIBILITY_ID, "BackButton").click()
time.sleep(0.5)
driver.execute_script("mobile: pressButton", {"name": "home"})
time.sleep(0.5)

# The note’s first two lines are confirmed. I’ll find Delta Chat to retrieve Bob’s historical message.
size = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": size["width"] * 0.5, "y": size["height"] * 0.815})
time.sleep(0.5)
driver.switch_to.active_element.send_keys("Delta Chat")
time.sleep(0.7)
print([(e.get_attribute("type"), e.get_attribute("name")) for e in driver.find_elements(AppiumBy.IOS_PREDICATE, 'visible == true AND (type == "XCUIElementTypeIcon" OR type == "XCUIElementTypeButton" OR type == "XCUIElementTypeStaticText")')][:45])

# Delta Chat appears as the top app result. I’ll open it and inspect its search controls.
driver.find_element(AppiumBy.IOS_PREDICATE, 'type == "XCUIElementTypeIcon" AND name == "Delta Chat"').click()
time.sleep(0.7)
print(driver.page_source[:18000])

# Bob’s chat contains multiple marker matches. I’ll search for the historical message before copying it.
driver.find_element(AppiumBy.ACCESSIBILITY_ID, "BackButton").click()
time.sleep(0.5)
fields = driver.find_elements(AppiumBy.CLASS_NAME, "XCUIElementTypeSearchField")
if fields and fields[0].is_displayed():
    fields[0].click()
    fields[0].send_keys("ops_launch_green_2026")
    time.sleep(0.5)
print([(e.get_attribute("type"), e.get_attribute("name"), e.get_attribute("value")) for e in driver.find_elements(AppiumBy.IOS_PREDICATE, 'visible == true AND (type == "XCUIElementTypeSearchField" OR type == "XCUIElementTypeButton" OR type == "XCUIElementTypeStaticText")')][:70])

# Saved Messages is empty. I’ll reveal chat search and locate Bob’s historical marker.
size = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: dragFromToForDuration", {"fromX": size["width"] * 0.5, "fromY": size["height"] * 0.19, "toX": size["width"] * 0.5, "toY": size["height"] * 0.52, "duration": 0.5})
time.sleep(0.6)
fields = driver.find_elements(AppiumBy.CLASS_NAME, "XCUIElementTypeSearchField")
if fields:
    fields[0].click()
    fields[0].send_keys("ops_launch_green_2026")
    time.sleep(0.6)
print([(e.get_attribute("type"), e.get_attribute("name")) for e in driver.find_elements(AppiumBy.IOS_PREDICATE, 'type == "XCUIElementTypeSearchField" OR type == "XCUIElementTypeStaticText" OR type == "XCUIElementTypeButton"')][:65])

# The drag entered selection mode instead of search. I’ll cancel and use a quick downward swipe.
size = driver.get_window_size()
driver.execute_script("mobile: tap", {"x": size["width"] * 0.105, "y": size["height"] * 0.082})
time.sleep(0.5)
driver.swipe(int(size["width"] * 0.5), int(size["height"] * 0.24), int(size["width"] * 0.5), int(size["height"] * 0.62), 200)
time.sleep(0.5)

# Search is now visible; I’ll look up Bob’s exact marker.

cases.instruction:
Create two Markdown notes in FSNotes and deliver a sequence of messages and shared note attachments to the “Saved Messages” chat in Delta Chat.

The first FSNotes note must be titled “Mobile Brief 0728” and contain, in order, the line “# Mobile brief”, a line break, the exact text of the historical message containing “nav_bar_search_token_nora_2606” from the “Nora QA” chat in Delta Chat, a line break, the line “Scope build 166”, a line break, the line “Owner Alice”, a line break, the line “Design decision”, a line break, the exact text of the historical message containing “design_search_anchor_alice_avatar” from the “Alice Design” chat in Delta Chat, a line break, and the line “Gate mobile ready”. The second FSNotes note must be titled “Mobile Risks 0728” and contain, in order, the line “# Mobile risks”, a line break, the exact text of the historical message containing “ops_launch_green_2026” from the “Bob Ops” chat in Delta Chat, a line break, the line “Risk no Sev1”, a line break, the line “Ops green”, a line break, the line “Route decision”, a line break, the exact text of the historical message containing “route_final_blue_1740” from the “Mei Chen” chat in Delta Chat, a line break, and the line “Gate ship ready”.

The “Saved Messages” chat in Delta Chat must contain, in order, a message containing exactly “iOS brief synced”, the shared “Mobile Brief 0728” note, the shared “Mobile Risks 0728” note, and a message consisting of two lines where the first line is “Brief archived” and the second line is “Gate ready”.

cases.instruction: Mark all notifications as read and complete the incident engagement workflow on the Home feed by saving, reposting, and liking the post by Devon Brooks whose body begins with "Post-incident", then replying to it with the exact text "incident owner". Save, like, and repost the post titled "Runbooks age quietly" and reply to it with the exact text "runbook owner set". Create a new post with the exact text "incident brief", ensure it is saved, reposted, and liked, and submit a reply to it with the exact text "owner update". Create a second new post with the exact text "risk ledger", ensure it is reposted, saved, and liked, and submit a reply to it with the exact text "impact noted". Create a third new post with the exact text "service recap", ensure it is liked, saved, and reposted, and submit a reply to it with the exact text "next check". Save, like, and repost the post titled "Support inbox triage" and reply to it with the exact text "owner path clear". Repost, like, and save the post titled "Customer thread pattern" and reply to it with the exact text "status owner next". Save and like the post titled "Security review reminder". Update the profile of Alex Chen, the author of the "service recap" post, by clearing the existing display name and setting it to "Alex Incident", clearing the existing bio and setting it to "incident owner", and removing the current profile photo to leave the avatar empty, then save the profile changes.

cases.instruction: Open Marble. Use the search bar at the top to search for "Tokyo". Click on the search result to center the map on Tokyo. Use the scroll wheel or zoom slider to zoom in until you can see the city label "Tokyo" on the map. Click on the city label to open an info card. Note the coordinates shown in the card. Then search for "Seoul", zoom in, click the label, and note its coordinates. Then search for "Beijing", zoom in, click the label, and note its coordinates. Then switch to the already-open LibreOffice Impress window. Create a new presentation. On the first slide, use Insert → Text Box to add a text box and type "East Asian Capital Cities" as the title. Then add another text box below it with the coordinates you noted for each city in the format: "Tokyo: [coordinates] Seoul: [coordinates] Beijing: [coordinates]" Save the presentation as /home/user/Documents/east_asia_cities.odp. Finish after the presentation is saved.

cases.instruction: Open Zotero. Create a new collection named "Computer Science" under My Library. Create a subcollection named "Databases" under "Computer Science". To create a subcollection, right-click on "Computer Science" in the left sidebar and select "New Subcollection". Type "Databases" and press Enter. Create another subcollection named "Networking" under "Computer Science". Add two Book items to the "Databases" subcollection: 1. "Designing Data-Intensive Applications" by Martin Kleppmann 2. "Database System Concepts" by Abraham Silberschatz Add two Journal Article items to the "Networking" subcollection: 1. "A Protocol for Packet Network Intercommunication" by Vint Cerf 2. "The Byzantine Generals Problem" by Leslie Lamport Add the tag "foundational" to all four items. To add a tag, select an item, then in the right panel click the Tags tab, click Add, and type "foundational". Add a child note to "Designing Data-Intensive Applications". To add a note, right-click the item and select Add Note. Type "Covers distributed systems, replication, partitioning, and consistency models." Add a child note to "A Protocol for Packet Network Intercommunication". Type "Seminal paper on TCP/IP architecture." Select the "Computer Science" collection. Go to File → Export Collection. In the export dialog, choose "BibTeX" format and export. The file will be saved to /home/user/Documents/cs_refs.bib. Finish after the BibTeX file exists.

cases.instruction: In Thunderbird's Calendar, dismiss any popup that appears (without logging out), move to the week of July 6 to July 10, 2026, and create a set of nine events that all persist in the local calendar, each title appearing exactly once. "Kickoff Alignment" must be on July 6, 2026 from 09:20 to 10:00. "Requirements Freeze" must be on July 6, 2026 from 13:10 to 13:55 with a single reminder 15 minutes before. "Prototype Review" must be on July 7, 2026 from 10:30 to 11:15. "Data Migration Check" must be on July 8, 2026 from 08:45 to 09:30 with a reminder 15 minutes before. "Stakeholder Demo Prep" must be on July 8, 2026 from 15:00 to 15:50. "Security Review Window" must be on July 9, 2026 from 11:40 to 12:20 with a reminder 30 minutes before. "Weekly Delivery Sync" must be on July 10, 2026 from 09:00 to 09:35, repeating every week (Weekly), with a reminder 30 minutes before. "Launch Decision Brief" must be on July 10, 2026 from 16:15 to 17:00; it is first saved without a description and then edited so that its description is exactly "Decision owners confirmed". "Release Readiness" must be on July 9, 2026 from 14:00 to 14:40 with a reminder 15 minutes before and the description "Review launch blockers". Events without a stated reminder, repeat rule, or description should keep none, and every event must be saved with Save and Close so the week plan retains the release events and their descriptions.

cases.title: Attach a source document and PDF to a draft
cases.summary: Follow the recorded actions and compare the final screenshot with the archived evaluator verdict.
cases.focus: This is a selected archived attempt, not an aggregate score or a claim that every action succeeded.
cases.evidence: Archived final-state evaluator: PASS. This verdict is preserved from the source run.
cases.instruction: In LibreOffice Writer, the document Bench Launch Memo is already open. Prepare a launch review packet. Create a folder on the Desktop named Bench_Launch_Packet. Save an editable copy of the open document into that folder as Bench_Launch_Memo_Copy.docx, then export the saved copy to the same folder as Bench_Launch_Memo.pdf. In Bench_Launch_Packet, create Bench_Launch_Attachments.csv with exactly these six comma-separated lines in this order: file,purpose,location; Bench_Launch_Memo.docx,source memo,Desktop; Bench_Launch_Memo_Copy.docx,editable launch copy,Bench_Launch_Packet; Bench_Launch_Memo.pdf,review PDF,Bench_Launch_Packet; Bench_Launch_Routing.txt,routing note,Bench_Launch_Packet; Bench_Launch_Checklist.txt,send checklist,Bench_Launch_Packet. Also create Bench_Launch_Routing.txt in that folder with exactly these four non-empty lines in this order: Draft owner: PMO, Approval owner: Maya Chen, Review lane: launch-readiness, Send status: hold for manual review. Create Bench_Launch_Checklist.txt in that folder with exactly these four non-empty lines in this order: Source memo included, Editable copy saved in packet folder, PDF exported from saved copy, Thunderbird draft kept unsent. Then switch to the already-open Thunderbird compose window with subject Bench Dual Attachment Review and attach exactly these files: Bench_Launch_Memo.docx from the Desktop plus Bench_Launch_Memo_Copy.docx, Bench_Launch_Memo.pdf, Bench_Launch_Attachments.csv, Bench_Launch_Routing.txt, and Bench_Launch_Checklist.txt from the Bench_Launch_Packet folder. Leave the draft open without sending it.
cases.evaluationMessage: Guest-side command check passed

cases.instruction:

Review the Account Wallet with Visa ending in 4242 selected, the Coupons panel, and the Saved places panel with Home selected, closing those panels after each review. cases.instruction:
Execute a comprehensive multi-route navigation review in the OpenNavigation application by completing eight sequential navigation sessions for Stanford University, Meta Headquarters, Googleplex, and Mountain View Transit Center. Each session must result in an active navigation state where the route overview is displayed and the session is subsequently ended, with the interface consistently displaying the OpenNavigation identity and utilizing the Route controls, Start, Overview, and End functions.

The first session targets Stanford University from the Saved locations list, requiring the Walk travel mode and the first available walking route card. During this active navigation, the voice icon near the Report option must be interacted with before the Overview is viewed and the session is ended. The second session targets Meta Headquarters from the Recent locations list, requiring the Drive travel mode and the first available driving route card, with the Overview opened to review route details before ending the session. The third session targets Googleplex from the Recent locations list, requiring the Bike travel mode with the departure time configured via the Other time option to Leave now, and the top cycling route card selected. During this navigation, the voice icon near the Report option must be interacted with, the Overview opened, and the session ended. The fourth session targets Mountain View Transit Center from the Recent locations list, requiring the Transit travel mode and the first available transit route card, with the Overview opened to view the transit route summary before ending the session.

The fifth session returns to Stanford University from the Saved locations list, requiring the Bike travel mode and the first cycling route card, with the Overview opened before ending the session. The sixth session returns to Meta Headquarters from the Recent locations list, requiring the Walk travel mode and the first walking route card, with the Overview opened, the voice icon near the Report option interacted with, and the session ended. The seventh session returns to Googleplex from the Recent locations list, requiring the Drive travel mode and the first driving route card, with the Overview opened before ending the session. The eighth and final session returns to Mountain View Transit Center from the Recent locations list, requiring the Transit travel mode with the departure time configured via the Other time option to Leave now, and the first transit route card selected, with the Overview opened to view the route before ending the session. Throughout the entire process, no options related to Coffee Option or Hotels Option may be selected.
cases.evaluationMessage: OpenNavigation navigation sessions verified

cases.instruction: If OpenNote asks you to sign in, use the username lina and the password note2026. In the OpenNote application, complete a workflow that results in specific notes being liked, saved, and commented upon, a user being followed, a new post being created, and profile details being updated. The note titled "Desk cable cleanup after I found three mystery screws" in the Explore section under the Home category must be liked, saved, and have the comment "Cable idea" added, with the #plant corner tag selected from that note. The note titled "Tiny adjustments that made open shelf edit work" must be liked, saved, and have the comment "Shelf saved" added. The author profile for June Ellis must be opened and followed, and from her profile, the note titled "Balcony watering after I underestimated how dusty the shelf was" must be saved, liked, and have the comment "Water check" added. The first visible note cover in the Following feed must be saved, and all notifications in the Alerts section must be marked as read. A new post in the Home category must be created with the title "Desk bay," the body "Cable tray note," the location "Desk side," the tags "desk" and "plant," and the first available cover option, and this newly created "Desk bay" note must be liked, saved, and have the comment "Desk saved" added. The profile fields in My Profile must be updated so that the Role is "Desk curator" and the Bio is "Keep desk notes," and the profile must be saved. The note titled "Weekday ramen, tested with a hair tie" in the Food category of Explore must be liked, saved, and have the #picnic tag selected, and the note titled "A real-life test of cold brew walk" must be liked, saved, and have the comment "Is it tasty" added, leaving the application in this final state.

cases.instruction:
Open the OpenPhotoEdit web application and produce two edited image files, portrait_window_before_edited.jpg and portrait_window_detail_edited.jpg, derived from the source files portrait_window_before.jpg and portrait_window_detail.jpg located in the /home/user/Desktop/attachment folder.

The first output, portrait_window_before_edited.jpg, must be based on the portrait of a person by a window featuring an RGB calibration color block in the upper-left corner. Its global adjustments must include Portrait settings of Smooth 26, Whiten 16, Rosy 14, Lip Color 12, Slim Face 8, Big Eyes 6, Bright Eyes 22, and Background Blur 32; Edit settings of Exposure +16, Brightness +10, Contrast -10, Saturation +12, Temperature +6, and Sharpen +8; and HSL settings of Red +12, Orange +10, and Yellow -7. Local adjustments must include Dodge brush work with Size 18 and Strength 36 on the shadowed side of the person's face and darker areas under the eyes, Burn brush work with Size 20 and Strength 30 on overexposed highlights on the window or reflections on the white wall, and Heal brush work with Size 10 and Strength 44 to remove small blemishes on the cheeks or small gray spots on the clothing. The RGB calibration color block must remain uncovered by any brush application.

The second output, portrait_window_detail_edited.jpg, must be based on the close-up of the same person. Its global adjustments must include Portrait settings of Smooth 22, Whiten 12, Rosy 15, Bright Eyes 26, and Background Blur 38; Edit settings of Exposure +9, Contrast -7, Temperature +6, and Sharpen +14; and HSL settings of Red +8, Orange +11, and Yellow -5. A Portrait preset from the Filters tab must be applied with a Strength of 51. Local adjustments must include Dodge brush work with Size 14 and Strength 34 on eye highlights and facial shadow areas, Heal brush work with Size 8 to remove small skin blemishes or stains on the background wall, Mosaic brush work with Size 16 and Strength 50 to obscure identifiable photos, IDs, door plates, or screen text in the background, and Burn brush work with Size 18 and Strength 28 on bright areas of the background curtains or white walls. The Mosaic and Burn brush applications must strictly avoid the person and the RGB calibration color block.

Both resulting images must be downloaded with their specified filenames, and the application state at completion should reflect that both files have been successfully exported.
cases.evaluationMessage: OpenPhotoEdit dual portrait exports verified

cases.instruction: Create and export a daily shift OpenSheet workbook containing a sales performance table, an inventory table, specific formatting, and view settings, saving the final file as a JSON document in /home/user/Downloads. The workbook title must be exactly daily shift. The first sheet must contain a table with the header row in row 1 containing Product in A1, Target in B1, Sold in C1, Diff in D1, and Status in E1. Row 2 must contain Espresso in A2, 80 in B2, 74 in C2, the formula =C2-B2 in D2, and watch in E2. Row 3 must contain Sandwich in A3, 45 in B3, 51 in C3, the formula =C3-B3 in D3, and good in E3. Row 4 must contain Juice in A4, 55 in B4, 60 in C4, the formula =C4-B4 in D4, and good in E4. Row 5 must contain Total in A5, the formula =SUM(B2:B4) in B5, the formula =SUM(C2:C4) in C5, and the formula =C5-B5 in D5. Cell A1 must be formatted with bold and center alignment, and cell B2 must be formatted as a Number with one decimal place. A chart preview must be generated from the data. A filter applied to the Status column for the value watch must be subsequently cleared so that no active filter remains in the final state. The grid density must be set to Compact, the panes must be frozen, and the zoom level must be set to 125%. A second sheet must exist containing an inventory table with the header row in row 1 containing SKU in A1, Item in B1, Stock in C1, and Need in D1, followed by the row in row 2 containing B-101 in A2, Beans in B2, 18 in C2, and 24 in D2. The Audit formulas action must be triggered. The workbook must be exported using the OpenSheet JSON format so that a parseable JSON file named daily-shift*.json is saved in /home/user/Downloads containing the workbook title daily shift and the expected cell contents from both sheets. OpenSheet is a web app: open it from the OpenSheet icon in the webpage folder on the desktop, which opens it in Chrome.
